outages.headline: Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea crude bypass peaks in March and declines 41% by June
outages.summary: Saudi Arabia redirected virtually all crude exports through its East-West Petroline to Yanbu on the Red Sea following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz in late February, reaching a peak of approximately 4.07 million barrels per day in March.
